About Us

Our Story

Karni Fig Fusion Pvt. Ltd. is building a brand around the versatility of figs, bringing traditional fruit inspiration into contemporary food and beverage ideas.

Our name honours Maa Karni of Deshnok and reflects our ambition to build a trusted, quality-focused Indian brand.
